item.tib: 'chi med mgon po tshe dpag med kyi sgrub pa las tshogs bdag glang gdong sgrub thabs rdo rje gsang ba gtum po'i le'u
item.coloph: bdag 'dra snyigs ma'i kho bo sangs rgyas gling pas/ mkha' 'gro'i lung rig lho tsha ba rong gi sbas yul pad ma 'bum gling gi nub phyogs su/ gnas chen nam mkha' mdzod kyi yang dben nas/ sa mo bya'i lor hor zla bdun pa'i tshesabacu'i nyinaH mi shig rdo rje'i dpal phug nas drangs te/ slar lcags pho khyi yi lor/ shar rgya mo rgya yi rong gi nye ba'i gdan sar bkra shis smin grol gling du/ shog ser las zhal bshus grub pas/ rgyud 'dzin tshe'i rang dbang thob nas dpal 'byor dbang thang mchog gi bstan pa rin po che dar rgyas su yong bar gyur cig/
